text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno Muteki diligently trains day in and 
day out. And on that very same track, her 
fellow classmates were there as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The hard-working Sakura Chiyono O tackles 
overcoming her weaknesses. It seems 
Maruzensky, whom she admires, is also 
lending a hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan was spotted at the gym. 
Despite her frail constitution, Mejiro 
Ardan was steadily training within her 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her two classmates train with 
single-minded focus, Yaeno Muteki felt a 
surge of fighting spirit, determined not 
to be outdone.
